page.layout: One block of text on one printed page: a title block at the top in capitals and italics, then a verse poem in one column with a woodcut initial at its left, ending with a catchword "SYL-" at the lower right. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.head: PAVLI MELISSI FRANCI, COMITIS PAL. EQVITIS AVR. ET CIVIS ROMANI, CONSILIARII Archipalatini, MELOS AD MELIOREM HAIMINSFELDIVM GOLDASTVM, Nobilem HELVETIVM.
main_text.p: VIC QVID abstrufo latet in recessu Sæculi GOLDASTE vetustioris, Eruis vulgans, & apertiores Mittis in auras. Additis sollerte notis Minervâ. Digna nimirum & pretiosa gaza Sunt libri, quos cura vigil sagaxq; Cœnobiorum Præstitit sartos hodieque tectos. FVLDA cum primis celebranda Francis, Deinde LAVRISSÆ domus ad beati Flumina Rheni, Integri custos veneranda LivI, Nescio quo furetagace rapti. Addé CORBEIÆ pluteos, sacrique Pulpita GALLI, Quæ tuus SCHOBINGER adire tuto, Tuque item quisti, studiose prisci Temporis, rarâque adeo repertu (Quorsus catur) Paginæ, quâ sestilus HVNIBALDI Prodidit, Reges veterum recensens Resque Francorum; licet ipse nugax Audiat auctor. Pluribus, queis nec tamen eius vmquam Scripta sint visa, aut aliquando lecta. Momon in tantum cacoëthes vrget Stare cauillis. Tu viâ cœptâ MELIOR secundis Perge sis astris, nitidiq; ductum LECTII prono sequere æmulatu, Aureæ Graii. Oris adsertor, Latiæq; linguæ; Excitus Famæ monitis, parentis Inter æquævos tibi Principatum, Ditequeregnum.

page.notes: The woodcut initial "V" at the start of the first verse line is a decorative ornamental block; read as "VIC QVID". The catchword "SYL-" is at lower right. Some words in the verse are set in spaced capitals and small capitals; ornament at the left of the first stanza is a woodcut frame, not text.
